//: Typecheck project for tests/portal ONLY. The root config maps '@/*' across all four app roots in order, because tsc cannot resolve an alias by which app the IMPORTER lives in — the thing vitest.config.ts does at runtime. That works while a specifier exists in exactly one app (apps/portal is the only one with lib/copy, so Shell resolves correctly), and breaks the moment two apps have the same one: `apps/portal/components/data.tsx` imports '@/lib/api', all four apps have a lib/api, and tsc picks apps/app's — which has no NotAnOrgAdminError. Ordering cannot fix it, because apps/app components import '@/lib/api' too and would break in the mirror image. So the portal's tests get their own project with '@/*' pinned to apps/portal, and the root config excludes them.
